notes: The draft was mis-parsed (section headers read as cards, Light side); rebuilt from the post as a Dark deck (the post is tagged Dark and the objective is Dark).
Byline posted as 'JAson "JasonKaye" Kaye'; capitalization fixed to Jason.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (5): My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Coruscant: Galactic Senate, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site, We Must Accelerate Our Plans and The Phantom Menace; these count toward the 60. We Must Accelerate Our Plans is a Used Interrupt, not a starting interrupt; kept where posted, plus x2 under Interrupts (3 in all).

Every card is from the Episode I sets (Tatooine, Coruscant); the post names no format. Sense, Alter and Control (posted without a set) and Coruscant dested the Dark Coruscant printings; Galactic Senate, Podrace Arena, Coruscant Guard, Vote Now! and Boonta Eve Podrace dested their Dark pages.

Posted 'Orn Free Ta' dested Orn Free Taa; 'Yeb Yeb Adem&þ' (mangled character) Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Drop' Drop!; 'This Is Outrageous' This Is Outrageous!; 'Podrace Collision' Podracer Collision; 'Nemoidian Advisor' Neimoidian Advisor; 'Sebulba's Racer' Sebulba's Podracer.
